name: foothold
description: Installable Obsidian vault pack for defence-sector founders. One bash command lays down a working second-brain: folder structure, page templates, skills, and pre-populated open-source defence reference content. Includes /foothold-setup (install and conversational onboarding), /foothold-rename (whitelabel the pack), and /foothold-update (pull new content as Foothold evolves).
